Clancy has admitted to killing her children — 5-year-old Cora, 3-year-old Dawson and 8-month-old Callan. Her attorney argues she should not be held criminally responsible, under what's known as the “insanity defense,” because she was not in her right mind at the time of the killings. He says her postpartum mental health issues were exacerbated by medications she was prescribed. [...] Prosecutors argue that Clancy deliberately killed the children because she wanted to “take them with her” when she unsuccessfully tried to kill herself that night. Clancy jumped from a second story window and is now paralyzed from the waist down.
